{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"\"Of Funerals and Fish\" is the pilot episode of the worlds longest running sitcom \"Last of the Summer Wine\" (1973–2010) written by Roy Clarke.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" Starring Bill Owen, Peter Sallis and Michael Bates.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" It was first aired on 4 January 1973 and became the first of 295 episodes.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" It was aired as a \"Comedy Playhouse\" episode.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":4,"text":" The plot was that the trio went around discussing life and death.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":5,"text":" It also was the first appearance of Kathy Staff although her character was at this point only known as Mrs Batty rather than Nora.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":6,"text":" Her husband, unseen in this first episode, is referred to as Harold; when the character went on to appear in the series, he would be called Wally.","title":"Of Funerals and Fish"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Kathy Staff (12 July 1928 – 13 December 2008), born Minnie Higginbottom, was an English actress, well known for her work on British television.","title":"Kathy Staff"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" She is most famous for her portrayal of Nora Batty on the longest running sitcom in the world, \"Last of the Summer Wine\".","title":"Kathy Staff"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"English actress Kathy Staff starred in the television show \"Of Funerals and Fish\", which ran for how many episodes?"}
